paper_title: VeloGraphX: Adaptive Exact Analytics for Evolving Graphs
correction_scope: Post-v3 repository-readiness cleanup: synchronize reviewer-facing status documents, persist selected raw paper evidence outside GitHub Actions retention, add anonymous/clean-room freeze verification, keep paper artifacts separate from the latest software release, document workflow status, and harden work-stealing task-exception accounting. No selector retuning, benchmark-result replacement, or manuscript quantitative-claim change.
freeze_policy: The release tag must point to the merged final manuscript-synchronized commit after all required CI, PVLDB paper-build, evidence-contract, and security checks pass. Submission tags are immutable; a newer freeze supersedes an older freeze rather than moving an existing tag. The release archive, checksums, evidence registries, manuscript, and reproduction instructions form the immutable submission artifact.
